name: audit-log
description: Workspace-scoped audit event recorder. Canonical logAuditEvent helper for mutations + actions; supports entity tracking, before/after diff, IP/user-agent capture. Frontend dashboard deferred (superspace-coupled).
notes: logAuditEvent helper lives at convex/_shared/auditLogger.ts. Mutation pattern: logAuditEvent(ctx, { action: 'feature.entity.verb', workspaceId, entityType, entityId, before?, after? }). Original `auditEvents` → namespaced `audit_log_events`.
